versions.content: 285 of 501  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Service Name <Module>_DemInitMonitorFor<EventName> Syntax Std_ReturnType <Module>_DemInitMonitorFor<EventName> ( Dem_InitMonitorReasonType InitMonitorReason ) Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) InitMonitorReason Specific (re-)initialization reason evaluated from the monitor to identify the initialization kind to be performed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType Return value unused - only for compatibility with according RTE operation. Description Inits the diagnostic monitor of a specific event. There is one separate callback per event (if configured), if no port interface is provided by the Dem. Available via Dem_Externals.h
